charges from the Doong Shing Lur (同興樓, 435 Foochow

Li Lai-chi (李蘭溪)
Shantung                                D. J. Macadie
Section 1,
Special Branch        7/5/34            Clerk Lok Wei-kong

My name is Li Lai-chi, age 51, native of Shantung,
and Manager of the Poong Ching Lou Restaurant. On May 23
a letter was received from the "Red Blood Traitors
Extermination Group" charging the shop with dealing in
Japanese goods and warning it to cease further dealings.
I inserted an advertisement in the Sin Wan Pao the
following day refuting the accusation. At about 10 a.m.
May 25 I received a telephone message from an unknown
person asking whether a letter had been received and
what action had been taken. In reply I stated that beyond
publishing an advertisement to refute the charge no action
has been taken. Subsequently, a person from the Society
Evening News came to my restaurant with a view to asking
me to publish advertisements which I refused. The next
day, news items alleging that my restaurant was dealing
in "bad" goods appeared in the said paper as well as in
the "Holmes" Mosquito paper.

At 4 p.m. May 27, one Gung Tsing-ching (孔景清)
from the Petty News called upon me in my shop. He
produced a copy of the Society Evening News and another
copy of "Holmes" and pointed out to me the items
relating to the sale of "bad" goods by my shop appearing
thereon, and asked me to publish advertisements of the
shop for three days, emphasising that it would not be
to the benefit of the shop if other papers continued to
publish such news. He further demanded a sum of
$300.00 as necessary for inserting advertisements in
pages.zh:
李兰溪（Li Lai-chi，李蘭溪）
山东                                D. J. Macadie
第一节，
特别处        34年5月7日            书记员 Lok Wei-kong

我叫李兰溪，51岁，山东人，丰庆楼餐厅经理。5月23日收到一封来自“铲除红血汉奸团”的信件，指控本店售卖日货，并警告停止此类交易。次日我在《新闻报》上刊登广告驳斥该指控。5月25日上午10点左右，我接到一个陌生人的电话，询问是否收到信件以及采取了什么行动。我回答说，除了刊登广告驳斥指控外，未采取其他行动。随后，一名来自《社会晚报》的人来到我的餐厅，要求我刊登广告，被我拒绝。第二天，该报以及《福尔摩斯》小报上出现了声称我餐厅售卖“坏”货的新闻报道。

5月27日下午4点，一名来自《小报》的孔景清（Gung Tsing-ching，孔景清）来到我的店里拜访我。他拿出一份《社会晚报》和一份《福尔摩斯》，向我指出上面有关我店售卖“坏”货的报道，并要求我刊登三天的店铺广告，强调如果其他报纸继续刊登此类新闻，对店铺不利。他还索要300.00美元，作为在

some 24 mosquito papers. For the sake of business and
being afraid of possible untoward incidents such as the
bomb throwing which recently occurred in the Wang Wa
Lou Restaurant, I offered a sum of $195.00 for the
advertisements. The visitor agreed to this sum and
consequently I paid the money to him and was given a
receipt. Up to the present I find, however, that
only some 16 mosquito papers have published the
advertisement some only for one or two days.

(Signed) Li Lai-chi.

约24家小报上刊登广告的费用。为了生意着想，也害怕发生类似最近王华楼餐厅发生的投掷炸弹等不幸事件，我出价195.00美元用于刊登广告。来访者同意了这个金额，于是我将钱付给他，并收到了一张收据。然而截至目前，我发现只有约16家小报刊登了该广告，其中有些仅刊登了一两天。

Hu Han-ts (胡憨珠), owner of the
"Pao Pao" Mosquito Paper.
haoshing                                      D. S. Mac Adie.
Sel, Sp. Branch      June 6, 1934,           Clerk Kao Yen-keng.

My name is Hu Han-ts.    I am a native of
haoshing, Chekiang, aged 28 and married.    I am
residing at No.1 Ching Yih Li (景益里), Rue Brenier
de Montmorand.    I am a reporter of the Eastern Times
and concurrently owner of the "Pao Pao" Mosquito Paper.
The "Pao Pao" (报报) is located at No.7 Ping An Li
(平安里), corner of Foochow and Chekiang Roads.
    About a week ago, one of my intimate friends
named Li Lai-chi (李賚池), proprietor of Dong Shing
Lur (同兴楼) Restaurant, Foochow Road, called me by
chit to discuss an important affair.    On meeting Li,
I was shown a list of mosquito papers in which advertisements
were to be inserted and a receipt for money for same, which
were written by Sung Tsing-ching (孫菁卿).    Li also
informed me of the circumstances under which Sung
approached him in connection with the advertisements.
Li went on to state that on the second day after the
receipt of the money by Sung, another advertisement broker
of a certain mosquito paper called on Li, saying that
the advertisement fee paid by Sung to the paper was not
large enough and therefore the paper did not wish to
accept the money.    The caller asked for "direct
negotiations", but was sent away by Li after being told
that the money had already been paid.    Mr. Li finally
solicited my assistance in devising some means to stop
these repeated calls from mosquito papermen, which were
annoying him.    In reply I advised that should anyone
pages.zh:
胡憨珠（Hu Han-ts，胡憨珠），《报报》小报业主。
haoshing                                      D. S. Mac Adie.
Sel, Sp. Branch      1934年6月6日,           书记员 Kao Yen-keng.

我叫胡憨珠。我是浙江haoshing人，28岁，已婚。我住在布伦尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）景益里（Ching Yih Li，景益里）1号。我是《字林西报》的记者，同时兼任《报报》小报的业主。《报报》（Pao Pao，报报）位于福州路与浙江路交界处的平安里（Ping An Li，平安里）7号。
大约一周前，我的一位密友，福州路同兴楼（Dong Shing Lur，同兴楼）餐厅老板李赉池（Li Lai-chi，李賚池），写便条约我商讨要事。见到李后，他给我看了一份拟刊登广告的小报名单以及相应的收款收据，这些均由孙菁卿（Sung Tsing-ching，孫菁卿）书写。李还告知了我孙就广告事宜接触他的情况。李接着说，在孙收钱后的第二天，某家小报的另一名广告经纪人拜访了李，称孙支付给该报的广告费不够多，因此该报不愿接受这笔钱。来访者要求“直接谈判”，但李告知钱已支付后将其打发走了。李先生最后请求我协助想办法阻止这些小报人员的反复骚扰，这让他很烦恼。我回答说，如果有人

pages.en:
- 2 -

call again, he be sent to my place so that I may explain
the matter to him and refer him to Sung Tsing-ching.

With regard to the name of Pao Pao appearing on
the list written by Sung, I have to state that I did
not ask Sung to act as my broker for advertisements
before this Dong Shing Lur case nor I was notified
after his receipt of the money.

I immediately sent for Sung with a view to
obtaining a knowledge of the exact conditions of the case.
Two days later, Sung accordingly came to me. I told
him that the Pap Pao is on specially friendly terms
with the Dong Shing Lur and requested him not to send
the advertisement to the Pao Pao, and to return the
money therefor to the Dong Shing Lur. Sung asked whether
the money should be returned through me. I told him
to return it direct to that restaurant. In addition,
I asked him to return any money which remained through
the non-insertion of advertisements in any of the papers
mentioned on the list. Thereupon Sung left. Since then
I have not secured any information about the case. I
do not know whether the Dong Shing Lur has received any
money returned by Sung.

Anti-Japanese Movement - Dong Shing Lur (同兴楼)
Restaurant in receipt of threatening letter -
Activities of mosquito paper reporters.

D. S. Mac Adie

On May 23, the Dong Shing Lur Restaurant, 435
Foochow Road, received a threatening letter from the
"Red Blood Traitors Extermination Group" against dealing
in Japanese products. The restaurant published an
advertisement in the Sin Wan Pao dated May 24 refuting the
allegation (Vide previous report of undersigned dated
May 25, 1934).

At 10 a.m. on May 25, the restaurant received a
telephone message from an unknown person enquiring whether
it had received a letter from the "Red Blood Traitors
Extermination Group" and whether the police had been informed
of the matter. In reply the shop acknowledged the
receipt and stated that the police had assigned a detective
to investigate the case following the appearance of the
reply published in the press.

At 4 p.m. on May 27, Sung Tsing-ching (孙晋卿),
Chief of Advertisement departments of the Ta Mei Wan Pao
(大美晚报), 19 Avenue Edward VII, and the Petty News
(小日报), 264 Hankow Road, interviewed Li Iai-chi
(李爱池), Manager of the Restaurant, in the shop on
Foochow Road. During the interview, Sung produced a copy
of the May 25th issue of Society Evening News and the
May 26th issue of the "Holmes" mosquito paper and showed
the manager the items therein regarding the sale of
Japanese products by the Dong Shing Restaurant. He
intimated that the restaurant should arrange the case with
the local mosquito papers by having advertisements published
on them. He said that a sum of $180.00 should be paid
for the insertion of advertisements for three days in 24

反日运动——同兴楼（Dong Shing Lur）
餐馆收到恐吓信——
小报记者的活动。

D. S. Mac Adie

5月23日，位于福州路435号的同兴楼餐馆收到一封来自“赤血除奸团”的恐吓信，指控其经销日货。该餐馆在5月24日的《新闻报》上刊登广告驳斥这一指控（参见本人1934年5月25日的先前报告）。

5月25日上午10时，餐馆接到一名身份不明者的电话，询问其是否收到“赤血除奸团”的信件，以及是否已就此事项通知警方。店方答复确认已收到信件，并表示鉴于已在报端刊登辟谣声明，警方已指派一名侦探调查此案。

5月27日下午4时，《大美晚报》（Avenue Edward VII 19号）广告部主任及《小日报》（汉口路264号）记者孙晋卿（Sung Tsing-ching），在福州路的店内会见了餐馆经理李爱池（Li Iai-chi）。会谈期间，孙出示了5月25日的《社会晚报》和5月26日的《霍尔姆斯》（Holmes）小报，并向经理展示了其中关于同兴楼餐馆销售日货的报道。他暗示餐馆应通过在这些本地小报上刊登广告来了结此事。他说，需在24家

paid to the Society Evening News which would publish an
advertisement refuting the allegation against the restaurant.
The caller also threatened the proprietor of the restaurant
that should he fail to comply, more articles against the
restaurant for dealing in Japanese goods would appear in the
local mosquito press.

At 6 p.m. on May 28, the restaurant paid
the above sums to the newspaper reporter, for which the
latter gave a receipt, the money being stated to be paid
as advertisement charges.

Up to to-day, June 4, only sixteen of the local
mosquito papers have published the advertisement of the
restaurant either for one day, two days or three days.

Between May 25 and June 1, Woo Shiao-tung (胡曉東),

( 明星日報 ) called at the shop no less than four times
on the same object, but was not successful.
